_comment: PRODUCTION CONTROL - reference only. This lab does NOT apply it.
Layer 1 (the client gate) and layer 2 (region-bound inference profiles) are
both demonstrable without changing the account. This is the third layer: an
identity-based control that denies the call outright.
IMPORTANT: an IAM policy cannot restrict the account ROOT user - root is not
subject to identity policies attached to itself. Applying this requires a
scoped IAM role or user (or an Organizations SCP for account-wide enforcement),
which is a deliberate account change and outside the scope of a lab exercise.
